title: 手持激光焊机：激光焊接安全培训
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/25_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Safety Training on Laser Welding.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/25_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Safety Training on Laser Welding/src.py

points.K2: 戴对应波长的激光防护眼镜
points.K3: 受控区内使用，进入者受训防护
points.K4: 两种光：红色定位光和红外光
points.K5: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
points.K6: 远离反射区，不看出光口
points.K8: 出光口不对任何身体部位
points.K10: 不放易燃物，不焊易燃物容器
points.K11: 急停按钮：按下停机，旋出复位
points.K12: 钥匙启用激光，可做门禁联锁
points.K13: 保护气瓶远离加工区和反射路径
points.K14: 工件感应线夹工件，不夹焊头
points.K15: 焊接四步：使能、贴合、就绪、扣扳机
points.K16: 不手持工件，手不放工件下
points.K18: 只从焊头后方观察熔池
points.K19: 有人进反射区，立即停光
points.K23: 暂停关使能，结束关电关气

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣戴着激光防护面罩，站在激光焊接工位旁招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears an orange laser safety face shield pushed up on its head and waves beside a handheld laser welding station.
shots.narration: 这一课是手持式激光焊接的安全培训。
overlay: 手持式激光焊接安全培训

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 光束、防护、部件、操作、停机五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a diverging beam cone, a face shield, an emergency stop button, a welding gun, and a power switch turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 光束、防护、部件、操作、停机，五部分。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰什么防护都没戴，拿起手持激光焊枪
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a handheld laser welding gun without any protective gear.
shots.narration: 阿杰什么都没戴，就想试试激光焊接。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研站在旁边，正对着焊枪口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands right beside him, directly in front of the welding gun nozzle.
shots.narration: 小研就站在焊枪旁边看。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师快步走来，抬手示意停下
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hurries over and raises her hand to signal stop.
shots.narration: 王老师叫停：先上完安全培训再说。

shots.section_title: 先培训、读说明，严格遵守
shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本空白安全说明书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank safety instruction booklet in a training room.
shots.narration: 用这台设备前，先看培训，读安全说明。
overlay: 先培训、读说明，严格遵守

shots.section_title: 先培训、读说明，严格遵守
shots.scene: 阿杰和小研看着屏幕上的培训视频
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student watch a training video on a screen attentively.
shots.narration: 所有安全规定，都要严格遵守。

shots.section_title: 先培训、读说明，严格遵守
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，身后一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up in front of a large shield icon.
shots.narration: 安全永远放在第一位。

shots.section_title: 戴对应波长的激光防护眼镜
shots.scene: 一副橙色激光防护面罩，镜片边缘有空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Close view of an orange laser safety face shield with a blank label on the edge of the visor. No people.
shots.narration: 操作时，一定戴好激光防护眼镜或面罩。
overlay: 戴对应波长的激光防护眼镜

shots.section_title: 戴对应波长的激光防护眼镜
shots.scene: 面罩标签和焊接机铭牌之间用箭头相连，打勾
shots.prompt_en: An arrow links the blank label on the face shield to a blank rating plate on the welding machine, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 它要能防护这台设备的激光波长。

shots.section_title: 受控区内使用，进入者受训防护
shots.scene: 一间带门的封闭焊接房，门上贴激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: An enclosed welding room with a door, opaque laser barrier panels and a laser warning sign on the door. No people.
shots.narration: 设备要在激光受控区里使用。
overlay: 受控区内使用，进入者受训防护

shots.section_title: 受控区内使用，进入者受训防护
shots.scene: 受控区四周是不透光的防护屏障
shots.prompt_en: Inside view of the controlled area surrounded by opaque laser barrier curtains on all sides. No people.
shots.narration: 四周设激光防护屏障，光出不去。

shots.section_title: 受控区内使用，进入者受训防护
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在门口穿戴好防护才进入
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student put on face shields and gloves at the door before entering.
shots.narration: 进去的每个人，都要培训过、穿戴好。

shots.section_title: 两种光：红色定位光和红外光
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一把焊枪的大示意图旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large diagram of a handheld laser welding gun.
shots.narration: 先看看光是怎么走的。
overlay: 两种光：红色定位光和红外光

shots.section_title: 两种光：红色定位光和红外光
shots.scene: 焊枪口射出一道细细的红色光点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welding gun emits a thin visible red dot onto a metal plate. No people.
shots.narration: 一种是看得见的红光，用来定位。

shots.section_title: 两种光：红色定位光和红外光
shots.scene: 焊枪口射出一道虚线表示的不可见光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welding gun emits a powerful invisible beam drawn as a dashed line. No people.
shots.narration: 另一种是看不见的大功率红外光，用来加工。

shots.section_title: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
shots.scene: 虚线光束过了焦点后，展开成一个锥形
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: past a focal point, the dashed beam spreads out into a wide cone. No people.
shots.narration: 红外光过了焦点，会发散成锥形。
overlay: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人

shots.section_title: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
shots.scene: 锥形光束越远颜色越浅
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the beam cone fades in color as it gets farther from the gun. No people.
shots.narration: 离得越远，能量越分散。

shots.section_title: 光束发散，远处仍能伤人
shots.scene: 锥形远端仍有眼睛和皮肤受伤的图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: at the far end of the faded cone, an eye icon and a skin icon still show small injury stars. No people.
shots.narration: 但远处的光，照样能伤眼睛和皮肤。

shots.section_title: 远离反射区，不看出光口
shots.scene: 工件周围画出一片红色的反射危险区
shots.prompt_en: Top view diagram: a red shaded reflection danger zone around the workpiece on the welding table. No people.
shots.narration: 工件周围是激光反射区，人要远离。
overlay: 远离反射区，不看出光口

shots.section_title: 远离反射区，不看出光口
shots.scene: 眼睛凑近出光口的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an eye looking into a welding gun nozzle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不要往出光口里看。

shots.section_title: 防护装备四件套
shots.scene: 四件防护装备排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four items in a row: an orange laser face shield, a heat-resistant jacket, heat-resistant gloves, and a dust mask. No people.
shots.narration: 受控区里的人，都要穿戴这些装备。
overlay: 防护装备四件套

shots.section_title: 防护装备四件套
shots.scene: 面罩镜片的空白认证标签特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the blank certification label on the laser face shield visor. No people.
shots.narration: 眼镜或面罩要经过认证，适配本机激光。

shots.section_title: 防护装备四件套
shots.scene: 面罩镜片特写，旁边浮现绿色标签
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the laser face shield visor with a small green tag floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 本机对应1080纳米，光密度OD6以上。

shots.section_title: 防护装备四件套
shots.scene: 老李穿上防护服、戴好耐热手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on a heat-resistant jacket and thick heat-resistant gloves.
shots.narration: 防激光耐热的衣服和手套，护住皮肤。

shots.section_title: 出光口不对任何身体部位
shots.scene: 焊枪口对着手臂、对着脸的图标，都被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a welding gun nozzle pointed at an arm and at a face, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 出光口不能对着身体任何部位。
overlay: 出光口不对任何身体部位

shots.section_title: 加工区配灭火器
shots.scene: 焊接机旁边立着一个灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher stands right beside the laser welding machine in the controlled area. No people.
shots.narration: 加工区要配好灭火器等安全设备。
overlay: 加工区配灭火器

shots.section_title: 不放易燃物，不焊易燃物容器
shots.scene: 纸箱、油布、喷雾罐图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of cardboard boxes, oily rags and spray cans, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加工区不放易燃、可燃的东西。
overlay: 不放易燃物，不焊易燃物容器

shots.section_title: 不放易燃物，不焊易燃物容器
shots.scene: 一个旧油桶被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An old closed oil drum and a used fuel can, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 装过易燃物的容器，绝对不能焊。

shots.section_title: 急停按钮：按下停机，旋出复位
shots.scene: 机器正面的红色急停按钮特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a red mushroom emergency stop button on a yellow base on the front of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 这是急停按钮。
overlay: 急停按钮：按下停机，旋出复位

shots.section_title: 急停按钮：按下停机，旋出复位
shots.scene: 一只手用力按下急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand firmly presses the red emergency stop button.
shots.narration: 一有异常，按下它，机器立即停止。

shots.section_title: 急停按钮：按下停机，旋出复位
shots.scene: 手旋转急停按钮，按钮弹起
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand twists the emergency stop button and it pops back up.
shots.narration: 排除问题后，旋转拔出按钮才能重启。

shots.section_title: 钥匙启用激光，可做门禁联锁
shots.scene: 机器上的钥匙接口，一把小钥匙插进去
shots.prompt_en: A small key plug is inserted into a key port on the front of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 插上专用钥匙，才能开启激光加工。
overlay: 钥匙启用激光，可做门禁联锁

shots.section_title: 钥匙启用激光，可做门禁联锁
shots.scene: 受控区门和机器之间画一条联锁连线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a line connects the controlled area door to the machine with a lock symbol; when the door opens, the laser icon turns off. No people.
shots.narration: 钥匙还能接门禁联锁，开门就停光。

shots.section_title: 保护气瓶远离加工区和反射路径
shots.scene: 机器背面插上保护气管
shots.prompt_en: A gas hose is plugged into the gas inlet on the back of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 激光焊接要用保护气。
overlay: 保护气瓶远离加工区和反射路径

shots.section_title: 保护气瓶远离加工区和反射路径
shots.scene: 气瓶用链条固定在推车上，离工位较远
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder secured with a chain on a cart stands well away from the welding table. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶放得远一些，固定好。

shots.section_title: 保护气瓶远离加工区和反射路径
shots.scene: 反射光扫向工位旁的气瓶，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a reflected beam sweeping toward a gas cylinder next to the welding table, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能放在激光反射的路径上。

shots.section_title: 工件感应线夹工件，不夹焊头
shots.scene: 感应线一端插进机器接口
shots.prompt_en: One end of a workpiece sensing cable is plugged into a port on the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 工件感应线，一端插在机器指定接口。
overlay: 工件感应线夹工件，不夹焊头

shots.section_title: 工件感应线夹工件，不夹焊头
shots.scene: 感应线另一端夹在台钳的工件上
shots.prompt_en: The other end of the sensing cable is clamped onto a workpiece held in a bench vise. No people.
shots.narration: 另一端夹在工件或导电工作台上。

shots.section_title: 工件感应线夹工件，不夹焊头
shots.scene: 夹子夹在焊枪头上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of the cable clamp attached to the welding gun head, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万不能夹在焊枪头上。

shots.section_title: 焊接四步：使能、贴合、就绪、扣扳机
shots.scene: 老李在触摸屏上点亮两个空白开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps two blank toggle icons on the touch screen of the machine.
shots.narration: 第一步：屏幕上开启出光和送丝。
overlay: 焊接四步：使能、贴合、就绪、扣扳机

shots.section_title: 焊接四步：使能、贴合、就绪、扣扳机
shots.scene: 焊枪头贴在工件上
shots.prompt_en: The welding gun nozzle rests in contact with the metal workpiece. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步：焊枪头接触工件。

shots.section_title: 焊接四步：使能、贴合、就绪、扣扳机
shots.scene: 焊枪手柄上的指示灯闪绿光
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the welding gun handle: a small indicator light flashes green as a gloved thumb presses a grip button.
shots.narration: 第三步：按握持键，绿灯闪，表示就绪。

shots.section_title: 焊接四步：使能、贴合、就绪、扣扳机
shots.scene: 老李扣下扳机，焊点发出亮光
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing a face shield, pulls the trigger and the weld spot glows brightly.
shots.narration: 第四步：扣下扳机，开始焊接。

shots.section_title: 不手持工件，手不放工件下
shots.scene: 一只手拿着工件焊接的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a hand holding a small metal workpiece while it is welded, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接时，不要用手拿着工件。
overlay: 不手持工件，手不放工件下

shots.section_title: 不手持工件，手不放工件下
shots.scene: 工件用台钳夹住，手远离焊点
shots.prompt_en: A workpiece is clamped in a bench vise, and the operator's free hand rests well away from the weld. No people.
shots.narration: 用夹具固定，手也别放在工件下面。

shots.section_title: 不手持工件，手不放工件下
shots.scene: 焊点周围的热浪图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of heat waves rising from a fresh weld seam. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接的热量，会把皮肤烫伤。

shots.section_title: 镜面反射和漫反射
shots.scene: 光束在两块钢板之间来回反射
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam bounces between two metal plates set at an angle. No people.
shots.narration: 激光会在多个表面之间反射。
overlay: 镜面反射和漫反射

shots.section_title: 镜面反射和漫反射
shots.scene: 光照到粗糙表面，散成一大片
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam hits a rough surface and scatters into many directions over a wide area. No people.
shots.narration: 粗糙表面的漫反射，会散到很大范围。

shots.section_title: 镜面反射和漫反射
shots.scene: 欣欣眯眼警惕地看着工位
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot watches the welding station alertly with a serious look.
shots.narration: 焊接全程，都要提防激光辐射。

shots.section_title: 只从焊头后方观察熔池
shots.scene: 老李站在焊枪后方，看着焊缝，绿色打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands behind the welding gun and watches the weld pool from behind, with a green check mark.
shots.narration: 观察熔池，只能站在焊枪后方。
overlay: 只从焊头后方观察熔池

shots.section_title: 只从焊头后方观察熔池
shots.scene: 有人侧身低头凑近焊点看的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a person bending sideways close to the weld spot to look, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别侧着、低着头凑到旁边看。

shots.section_title: 有人进反射区，立即停光
shots.scene: 阿杰走进反射区，老李立刻松开扳机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into the reflection zone; the facility engineer immediately releases the trigger.
shots.narration: 有人走进反射区，马上停止出光。
overlay: 有人进反射区，立即停光

shots.section_title: 金属未熔透，立即停止
shots.scene: 焊点没熔透，光散射出去的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the beam fails to melt through the metal at the weld spot and scatters outward in several directions. No people.
shots.narration: 金属没熔透，激光会从焊点散射出来。
overlay: 金属未熔透，立即停止

shots.section_title: 金属未熔透，立即停止
shots.scene: 老李松开握持键，指示灯熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lets go of the grip button and the indicator light goes off.
shots.narration: 发现这种情况，立刻停止加工。

shots.section_title: 时刻警惕，有风险就停
shots.scene: 老李放下焊枪，另一只手按下急停
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sets down the welding gun and presses the emergency stop button with his other hand.
shots.narration: 时刻保持警惕，发现风险就停光。
overlay: 时刻警惕，有风险就停

shots.section_title: 排走烟尘，戴呼吸防护
shots.scene: 排烟罩对着焊点吸走烟尘
shots.prompt_en: A fume extraction hood next to the weld spot draws the smoke away. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接烟尘可能含有有毒颗粒。
overlay: 排走烟尘，戴呼吸防护

shots.section_title: 排走烟尘，戴呼吸防护
shots.scene: 排风机图标亮起，烟尘被吸走
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a fume extraction fan switched on, drawing smoke away. No people.
shots.narration: 用排烟系统把烟尘排走。

shots.section_title: 排走烟尘，戴呼吸防护
shots.scene: 老李戴好呼吸防护用品和面罩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a respirator under his laser face shield.
shots.narration: 操作者还要戴好呼吸防护用品。

shots.section_title: 暂停关使能，结束关电关气
shots.scene: 老李在触摸屏上关闭两个开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps two blank toggle icons on the touch screen to switch them off.
shots.narration: 暂停时，关闭送丝和出光。
overlay: 暂停关使能，结束关电关气

shots.section_title: 暂停关使能，结束关电关气
shots.scene: 老李关掉机器电源开关，再关气瓶阀门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the machine's power switch and then closes the gas cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 做完了，关掉电源，再关气源。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在受控区门口，身后浮现几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of the laser controlled area with icons floating behind: a face shield, a beam cone, a stop button and a fan.
shots.narration: 受训进区，戴对防护，枪口不对人。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 图标：后方观察、有险就停、排烟关机
shots.prompt_en: Icons in a row: an eye behind a welding gun, a hand stopping, and a fan with a power switch off. No people.
shots.narration: 后方观察，有险就停，排烟关机。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 阿杰戴好面罩和手套，向王老师竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, now in a laser face shield and gloves, gives the safety administrator a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰穿戴好防护，才拿起焊枪。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera at the door of the controlled area.
shots.narration: 激光看不见，防护不能省。下次见！
